suggested_fix: No security fix required. The port index is bounds-checked against ARRAY_SIZE(altmode->ports) before use, duplicate ports are rejected, fwnode references are dropped on every early exit, and mux/retimer/switch references are released through devm actions. DRM bridges are allocated inside the loop but only added after all ports are set up, which avoids the earlier use-after-free in bridge registration. A minor cleanup would be to log the fwnode with %pfwP instead of %pOFn.
